purpose: Prepare matched CPU clean-history and noise-augmented Lite L10 fits at 30 and 300 km/h, then compare both training recipes on clean and paired noisy test histories after a separate root-approved fixed replay.

scope_boundary.comparison: Primary comparison is fresh clean-history versus 10/20/30 dB history-noise-augmented training at the same speed. All four fits share CPU backend, seed, initialization, first clean sample batch, optimizer budget, and the same fixed 20 dB noisy validation selector.
scope_boundary.claim_limit: Describe the paired training-recipe difference under the fixed 20 dB validation selection rule. This does not identify an optimal noise-level policy, prove seed robustness, or isolate robustness across other selection rules.
scope_boundary.replication: One seed per speed; do not claim seed robustness or perform inferential tests.
scope_boundary.test_access: Formal test artifacts were accessed historically. This follow-up remains non-blind; training and validation selection must exclude test, and later fixed test replay requires its own exact root approval.

a7_preflight_reuse.reuse_rule: Reuse the A7 hash-only train/validation inventory as data provenance only, never its fitted weights as the primary control. Verify exact preflight/source hashes, sidecars, execution identity, all nine completed receipts/configs/best/last/mirror hashes, 90/24 inventory, normalizer, and test_files_opened=[]; copy immutable bytes into this run output before fitting.

shared_recipe.loss: C0 normalized RI MSE over clean future targets
shared_recipe.normalizer: Reuse the exact A7 global RI mean/std fitted on only the 90 D1 training environments; never refit from validation or test.

channel_scale.rule: Use the single global C0 channel_scale fitted on all 90 D1 training environments across speeds. Reconstruct g as sqrt(sum(mean_RI^2 + std_RI^2)) from the equal-environment train-only RI normalizer moments; never replace it with a 30-environment speed-subset RMS.
channel_scale.reconciliation: Require the exact hash-bound training_statistics.json, exact 90 training IDs in both the normalizer and energy inventory, fit_splits=[train], equal-environment weighting, and agreement of stored global channel_scale with sqrt(sum(mean_RI^2 + std_RI^2)) within relative tolerance 1e-12. Verify the source-definition file hashes. Also require the 30/300 km/h historical C0 manifests to bind this same global value. Speed-subset RMS is logged only as a diagnostic.

source_definition.definition: sqrt(mean over all 90 train environments of each environment mean |H|^2)
equal-environment RI mean/std; global second moment equals sum(mean_RI^2 + std_RI^2)

allocation_per_epoch.counts: 1366,1365,1365; rotate the extra window across SNR levels in epoch order
allocation_per_epoch.schedule_rng: noise_augmentation_rng, independent of the uniform sampler RNG

history_noise_training.domain: Add independent complex Gaussian perturbations to raw observed histories before train-only RI normalization. Keep every future target clean and unchanged.
history_noise_training.repeat_draws: Noise is newly generated per sampled window presentation; the noise RNG state is saved and restored separately from the sampler RNG.
history_noise_training.clean_control: No history perturbation. It uses the same clean sampled histories, first-batch sampler addresses, initialization seed, optimizer, epoch schedule, validation noise, and selection metric as its speed-matched noiseaug fit.
history_noise_training.noise_rng: One independent NumPy PCG64 Generator seeded 2602236. For each presented row, draw a standard-normal array with the fixed [10,8,32,2] shape and scale it for that row SNR. There are no per-row child generators. Given the same row presentation order, splitting calls into minibatches does not change the noise stream.
history_noise_training.reference_scale: The single fixed global train-only channel_scale reconstructed from the exact 90-environment normalizer; it is shared by the 30/300 km/h fits, validation, and later test SNR definitions.

validation_selection.noise_scope: Apply fixed 20 dB complex AWGN to raw validation histories using the same global training channel_scale for every recipe and epoch; future targets remain clean.
validation_selection.metric: Equal-environment mean physical linear NMSE across the eight speed-matched validation environments.
validation_selection.rule: Strict minimum; stop after 15 epochs without improvement. Regenerate identical address-paired validation input noise from the fixed seed for every environment/origin/user each epoch; the noise is invariant to batching/order. Never inspect test to select a checkpoint.
validation_selection.address_key: Fixed seed + environment ID + origin + user; therefore validation noise is invariant to evaluation batch size and processing order.
validation_selection.comparison: All four clean/noise fits use the same fixed 20 dB validation condition, seed, eight environments, equal-environment mean physical linear NMSE, and strict-minimum selection rule.
validation_selection.noise_generator: Validation-only SHA-256-addressed NumPy PCG64 noise keyed by seed 2602237, environment ID, origin, and user. This differs from the frozen A1/Philox test-history transform; do not reuse the validation seed or transform for test.

precision_and_resources.device: local CPU only for all four primary fits
precision_and_resources.runtime_recording: Set both TF32 flags explicitly in each child process and record actual backend values in config, execution record, and last checkpoint. CPU backend is shared by the four primary clean/noise fits; existing A7 GPU fits are secondary references, not the matched control.

checkpoint_and_recovery.authoritative_checkpoint: Atomic last.pt after every completed epoch.
last_state_includes: best selected model state and epoch/score
full learning curve through the committed epoch
sampler RNG state and per-environment/row counters
Python, NumPy, Torch CPU RNG state and an empty CUDA RNG list because every primary fit is CPU-only
stateless validation address seed and algorithm
run/config/source/preflight hashes and actual precision flags
checkpoint_and_recovery.resume_rule: Resume only from an identity-matched last.pt at an epoch boundary. Restore model with strict=True, optimizer, all RNGs, sampler counters, best state, and full curve. Rebuild a stale best/mirror or derived curve only from the authoritative last.pt and preserve changed artifacts as hash-named snapshots.
checkpoint_and_recovery.selected_model: best.pt stores the strict-validation-minimum model; mirror best.pt must match its SHA-256.

clean_comparator.primary_control: Fresh clean-history fit from scratch at the same speed on CPU under the same seed and validation/selection rule.
clean_comparator.historical_a7_role: The existing A7 L10 checkpoint was trained on CUDA and is secondary context only; it is not the primary matched control.

post_training_test_plan.target_condition: Clean future targets at every input condition.
post_training_test_plan.noise_rule: For 10/20/30 dB, use the exact frozen A1 history-noise transform: Philox with seed 2602236 and the single global train-only channel_scale, paired by environment/origin/user/time across clean/noise-trained fits. Clean-infinite-SNR inputs receive no noise. Do not reuse validation seed 2602237 or its SHA-addressed PCG64 transform.
post_training_test_plan.panel: 2 speeds x 2 CPU-fitted recipes x 4 input-history conditions x 30 environments = 480 environment-condition rows.

metrics: receiver-10-dB RZF mean sum spectral efficiency
evaluation.experimental_unit: independent environment; origins, users, and subcarriers are within-environment observations

post_training_test_plan.selection_boundary: No test-based selection, tuning, or protocol changes. Report the clean-to-noisy-input degradation separately from the clean-trained-versus-noiseaug training-recipe comparison. The fixed 20 dB validation selector does not establish an optimal noise-level policy.
requires: all four best checkpoints and mirrors hash-matched
separate root approval bound to the fixed manifest and runner hashes
post_training_test_plan.implementation_state: This training runner does not read or evaluate test data. A separate fixed evaluator must be reviewed after both fitted bundles are frozen.
post_training_test_plan.matched_comparison: Primary fit-recipe comparison is noiseaug versus clean-history at the same speed, with both fitted on CPU and selected under the identical fixed 20 dB validation protocol. Existing CUDA-fitted A7 checkpoints are secondary context only.
post_training_test_plan.noise_reference_scale: The same hash-bound global training_statistics.json channel_scale defines SNR for both speeds, validation, and test.

launch_review_contract.concurrency: A single OS-managed exclusive output lock serializes all four child fits; it is released automatically when the process exits.
